title: Lena-Winslow brings high-energy 'Newsies' to the stage - NewsBreak
text:
By Nida Tazeen ,
1 days ago The Lena-Winslow Music Department will present the Broadway hit "Newsies."
The musical will be presented March 20-22, according to a community announcement.
Inspired by the real-life newsboys strike of 1899, "Newsies" follows Jack Kelly and a band of young newspaper sellers who fight back against powerful publishers after unfair price increases threaten their livelihood. What begins as a struggle for survival becomes a movement as the newsies discover the strength of standing together and making their voices heard.
The cast and crew consists of 60 students, faculty and volunteers.
The spirit of collaboration "The story of Newsies is about young people discovering the power of their voices together, and that same spirit shaped our own production," musical director Renee Schultz said. "Many of the creative ideas you'll see on this stage were sparked by students in rehearsal, making this show a true collaboration."
Schultz praised the work of the production’s costumer, Tillie Coomber.
"Our costumer, Tillie Coomber, has put in a great deal of time and effort into this show, and I am so grateful for her positive attitude no matter how many changes or additions I throw at her during rehearsals," Schultz said.
'Newsies' showtimes and ticket information The performances will be 7 p.m. March 20-21 and 3 p.m. March 22, according to the announcement.
Audience members should enter through the Panther Den entrance behind the junior high, with doors opening 30 minutes prior to each performance.
Tickets are available at the door for $10 for adults and $5 for students.
